units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:4:11">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:5">Deut. VII, 5</cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="C00638"><he>גִּידּוּעִין</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="C00639"><he>גִּידּוּעֵי</he></cite>. Bab.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 45b:10">Ab. Zar. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ ע״א</he> the execution of the laws concerning the destruction of objects used for idolatry.

senses.gloss: that which grows out of a stump; cmp. גֶּזַע. Ib. שגִּידּוּעוֹ אסור וכ׳ the fresh growth of which is forbidden while the root is permitted; 48ᵃ
